title: FoundryCarveOutRegistry
description: Foundry model carve-out registry. Normal quorum floors remain 3 for prod and 2 for dev/staging. An explicitly authorised quorum_waiver permits one approver across all environments until expires_on; PowerShell and OPA enforce expiry at runtime. Model review windows, regions and data-protection controls are not waived.

expires_on.description: Inclusive UTC expiry date for the approval-count exception only; does not extend model review_date.

min_approvers_prod.description: Spec 036 F-A4 NEW key. Minimum approver_identities count for `environment == "prod"` rows. Default 3 per FR-RAG-CV-01 + Pass 2 Q-P2-03.

min_approvers_dev.description: Spec 036 F-A4 NEW key. Minimum approver_identities count for `environment in {"dev", "staging"}` rows. Default 2 (spec-032 behaviour preserved).

model_name.description: Underlying model identifier from the proposed deployment's properties.model.name; not its deployment alias.

environment.description: Spec 036 F-A4 NEW field. Discriminator for the environment-aware quorum rule. Optional for backward compatibility with spec-032 rows; OPA treats a missing value as dev/staging.
